messages:
alex_m: Fri check-in — quick async: finished the IAM role cleanup for svc-inference (removed stale assume-role perms, left a note in the PR). Blocker: need someone from infra to confirm we can remove the legacy cross-account role 'ci-deploy-read'.

maya_r: Thanks Alex. Can you drop the PR link?

alex_m: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/pull/487 — description + before/after iam diff in the PR body.

chris_l: I can validate the cross-account role tonight. If we remove it, we need to update the terraform state in account-ops before Monday. ping me when PR is merged. :thumbsup:

samuel_g: On KMS rotation: did a dry run against staging keys, rotation script worked but kms-cli returned a 429 for 2 requests. Increasing retries helped. Plan: run full rotation Sunday 0200 UTC. Any objections?

maya_r: No objections. Please add a Runbook step for manual rollback and include the KMS key IDs in the ticket.

samuel_g: Will do. Ticket: SEC-2026 — added rotation plan + rollback. @engsec-bot can you attach recent key usage metric snapshot?

engsec-bot: Attached: /artifacts/SEC-2026/key-usage-2026-03-17.png (generated by audits-bot)

audits-bot: IAM scan results uploaded: /artifacts/SEC-2026/iam-scan-1978901200.json. Found 3 roles with overly permissive policies — two are already in Alex's PR, one belongs to legacy-onprem svc. Marked as 'needs-owner'.

alex_m: I'll take ownership of the legacy svc role next week (will coordinate with infra ops). For now, can we set a short-term rule to restrict the last principal to our deployment CI only? I'll open a follow-up PR.

chris_l: FYI I left review comments on Alex's PR regarding least-priv changes and an inline test suggestion — short unit test to ensure assume_role condition is correct.

maya_r: Quick ops ask: compliance wants the audit log retention confirmation for the past 6 months. I uploaded the retention CSV to SEC-2026. Anyone able to confirm the CloudTrail bucket lifecycle? @samuel_g?

samuel_g: Confirmed. Bucket lifecycle policy set to 540 days rollover, and we have multi-region replication. Added the policy snippet in the ticket.

alex_m: Final note — if infra can't validate deleting the cross-account role by EOD, we'll keep it and add a stricter tag for follow-up. Happy weekend everyone. :wave:
